FX-SKEY-001.says: The settings as they start: screen colour pure green, gain 100, balance 50, no clip, despill bias 50 at full strength. Pure green's top row is keyed out, its darker rows keep a share in step with their darkness; the green screen, less saturated than pure green, keeps about half its covering and loses its green spill; skin, the greys and the reds keep all of theirs.

FX-SKEY-002.says: Screen colour picked from the green screen (40, 180, 60): its top row is keyed out, its darker rows keep a little more each (their green stands less above the rest); pure green, more saturated than the screen, is gone in its top five rows; skin, greys, reds and blues are untouched apart from the despill.

FX-SKEY-003.says: Screen gain 150: more is keyed; the green screen's darker rows fall further and cyan and yellow, which stand half as far above, lose more.

FX-SKEY-004.says: Screen balance 0: the screen channel is measured against the larger of the other two, so yellow and cyan no longer read as screen.

FX-SKEY-005.says: Screen balance 100: against the smaller of the other two, so yellow and cyan read as screen as strongly as green.

FX-SKEY-006.says: Clip black 30, clip white 70: the matte below 0.3 is screen, above 0.7 foreground, stretched between; the green screen's darker rows clean up.

FX-SKEY-007.says: Clip black 53 and clip white 53: a hard matte, each pixel in or out.

FX-SKEY-008.says: Despill bias 0: the green is held to the larger of red and blue, the gentlest despill.

FX-SKEY-009.says: Despill bias 100: the green is held to the smaller of red and blue, the strongest despill.

FX-SKEY-010.says: Despill 0: the matte as FX-SKEY-002, the colours not despilled.

FX-SKEY-011.says: Blue screen (30, 70, 200) at balance 95, the advice for blue screens: the blue screen and its half-covered copy are keyed, pure blue is gone, and so are cyan, magenta and violet, whose blue stands as far above; pale blue keeps a share; green, yellow and red keep all their covering.

FX-SKEY-012.says: View screen matte, FX-SKEY-006's settings: the matte as grey, covering kept.

FX-SKEY-013.says: View status, FX-SKEY-006's settings: white where all foreground, black where all screen, one grey for every blend.

FX-SKEY-014.says: Shrink/grow -1: the foreground matte shrinks a pixel, so the columns beside the keyed green screen and pure green lose their covering too; the frame's own edge is not eaten.

FX-SKEY-015.says: Shrink/grow 1.5: the foreground matte grows a pixel and a half, filling the keyed green screen from its neighbours; pure green, between cyan and yellow that are keyed too at the top, stays keyed there.

FX-SKEY-016.says: Softness 1: the matte blurred at sigma 1, the edge between the screen and the foreground soft.

FX-SKEY-017.says: Edge refine 2: Refine Soft Matte's guided fit at radius 2 on the keyed result's edges.

FX-SKEY-018.says: Screen gain keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 200 at frame 4, linear: nothing keyed at frame 0, twice FX-SKEY-002's at frame 4.

FX-SKEY-019.says: FX-SKEY-014 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SKEY-020.says: Screen gain 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SKEY-021.says: Clip black -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SKEY-022.says: Shrink/grow 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SKEY-023.says: View "Status": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SKEY-024.says: Screen colour "green", not a #rrggbb colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
